result.summary: The client originally required a 95% test pass rate for acceptance. The Product Manager indicated that 90% would be acceptable for the pilot, but client approval has not been formally obtained. QA continues to use the 95% threshold in the acceptance checklist. No schedule impact was mentioned.

issues.description: QA is still using the 95% test pass rate threshold in the acceptance checklist, despite the Product Manager indicating that 90% would be acceptable for the pilot.
issues.impact: Potential misalignment between QA standards and the pilot's acceptance criteria.
evidence: QA is still using 95% in the acceptance checklist.

issues.description: Client approval has not been obtained for the 90% pass rate, even though the Product Manager suggested it would be acceptable for the pilot.
issues.impact: Uncertainty about whether the pilot will meet client acceptance criteria.
evidence: Client approval has not been obtained.

risks.description: Client may not approve the pilot if the 90% pass rate is not accepted as a valid alternative to the original 95% requirement.
risks.impact: Potential delay or rejection of the pilot.
evidence: Client approval has not been obtained.

requirement_changes.requirement: 95% test pass rate for client acceptance
evidence: Product Manager said that 90% would be acceptable for the pilot.

uncertainties.item: Whether the 90% pass rate will be accepted by the client for the pilot.
uncertainties.reason: Client approval has not been obtained.
uncertainties.needed_information: Client approval status for the 90% pass rate.

uncertainties.item: Whether the QA team will update the acceptance checklist to reflect the 90% pass rate for the pilot.
uncertainties.reason: QA is still using the 95% threshold.
uncertainties.needed_information: QA's plan to update the checklist.
